integrity: Reproducible exact finite enumeration with two separately structured standard-library programs; no claim of independent scholarly review or externally certified priority.
scientific_limitations: The scope is solely the Petersen graph and one-vertex addition/deletion of total dominating sets. The 332-state count is already implied by the known labelled triangle-free five-vertex graph count; no novelty is attributed to that count. The new finite distance assertions are established by exact exhaustive state and edge traversal. Historical priority is not independently certified.
title: Exact total-domination flip geometry of the Petersen graph
